description: This file defines a plugin for the dayjs library that adds business day calculations, including handling holidays, working days, and business day operations.

classes.name: BusinessDaysPlugin
classes.description: A plugin function for dayjs that adds business day related methods and options.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the current day is a holiday based on configured holiday list and format.

methods.name: isBusinessDay
methods.description: Determines if the current day is a business day, considering holidays, additional working days, and weekdays.

methods.name: isAdditionalWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if the current day is an additional working day.

methods.name: businessDaysAdd
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to the current date.

methods.name: businessDaysSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts a specified number of business days from the current date.

methods.name: businessDiff
methods.description: Calculates the number of business days difference between the current date and another date.

methods.name: nextBusinessDay
methods.description: Finds the next business day after the current date.

methods.name: prevBusinessDay
methods.description: Finds the previous business day before the current date.

methods.name: businessDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns an array of all business days in the current month.

methods.name: lastBusinessDayOfMonth
methods.description: Returns the last business day of the current month.

methods.name: businessWeeksInMonth
methods.description: Returns an array of weeks, each containing business days, for the current month.
